adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 rework closed the framework-test ticket for OAIP-1: activity rows are now primary-located, database rows preserve modification/mechanism/source conflicts, and final mechanism claims are bounded to the paper-supported evidence rather than database overclaims.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary Figure 2/PDF text support mature OAIP-1 with C-terminal amidation; DRAMP/dbAMP sequence fields do not encode the modification, so affected rows remain sequence_modified_not_normalized/source_conflict rather than clean source_verified.

The H. armigera oral LD50 appears as 104.2 +/- 0.6 pmol/g in the abstract/database row, 104.5 pmol/g in Results text, and 0.10 nmol/g in Table 2; all are preserved as source-located primary values instead of forced into one invented exact value.

Database text says probable ion-channel inhibitor, but the primary paper keeps the molecular target unresolved; final mechanism evidence is limited to phenotype, ICK/stability structure, synergy, and homology context.
Local DOCX supplements contain agar-diet components and mealworm phenotype scoring scheme; no hidden activity/toxicity table was found in opened DOCX or packet supplement table artifacts.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DRAMP/dbAMP rows were reconciled to primary DOI/PMID, Figure 2 sequence/modification evidence, source organism/name context, and activity endpoints. Source-supported insecticidal activity is retained; C-terminal amidation omission, duplicate DRAMP rows, unsupported dbAMP AntiSARS_COV text, and unresolved ion-channel wording remain explicit cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered eight source-located activity/toxicity records from primary text, Figure 1, Figure 3, and Table 2, including native mortality screens, synthetic LD50 endpoints, and imidacloprid synergy; no exact figure-only dose-response values were invented.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism output is bounded to excitatory phenotype, ICK/disulfide structure and stability context, synergy with imidacloprid, and homology context; the exact OAIP-1 molecular target is not assigned.
